description: Create a run: a plan of 1 to 16 steps that the service keeps and goes through in order, with its deadlines and recovery, for up to 24 hours. A step is delegate, a job workers claim through claim_agent_queue_job; wait, on time, an outside event or a person; decide, rules over the last result; and complete, always the last one. Returns run_id, read_token and control_token once, and for a plan with delegated steps queue_id and worker_token for the workers. With idempotency_key, a repeat after a lost answer returns the same run and tokens instead of a new run. Creation allows 20 per IP per UTC day. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

idempotency_key.description: 32 bytes from a secure random source as lower-case hex, the same for a repeat of the same plan.

steps.description: The steps in order. Each has id and type. delegate takes task and timeout_seconds, wait takes event (time, external or human) with delay_seconds or timeout_seconds, decide takes request with state and questions, and optional require.

ttl_seconds.description: The run's lifetime, fixed at creation and extended by nothing.
